items.title: 67247_J.C. Higginbotham oral history interview
items.q: He played there. I had a first cousin, a girl, used to play there. She played piano.

ctx.x: And Jay C. used to come up and play at the Eighty-One and Ninety-One?
He played there. I had a first cousin, a girl, used to play there. She played piano.
